name: shortcuts
description:
Motor de atajos y macros multi-paso con persistencia local en USERPROFILE. Acciones: create, execute, list, get, delete, rename, update, history, export, import, reload.
Acciones y argumentos (usar en args): add_shortcut { name, description, steps, category, tags } | backup_shortcuts { destination } | clear_all {} | create { name, description, steps, category, tags } | create_shortcut { name, description, steps, category, tags } | delete { name, all } | delete_shortcut { name, all } | edit { name, description, steps, category, tags } | execute { name, variables } | execute_shortcut { name, variables } | export_shortcuts { destination } | get { name } | get_shortcut { name } | history { name } | import_shortcuts { source, data, overwrite } | inspect { name } | list { category } | list_all { category } | list_shortcuts { category } | reload {} | remove { name, all } | rename { name, newName } | restore_shortcuts { source } | run { name, variables } | run_shortcut { name, variables } | save { name, description, steps, category, tags } | update { name, description, steps, category, tags }

action.description: Acción a ejecutar en el dominio shortcuts
